visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair and a black fabric headband looks directly into the camera lens with a bright, engaged expression. She is wearing a casual gray zip-up sweatshirt over a dark inner layer. She sits in a brightly lit cafe interior featuring warm wood paneling and glass display cases filled with baked goods in the background. (2) The camera transitions through a montage of various artisanal pastries arranged on stainless steel cooling racks. Close-up shots reveal a savory pizza-style bread topped with melted cheese and herbs, as well as round buns filled with whole mushrooms. Each item is accompanied by a small white price tag with black printed text. (3) The woman is shown again in a medium shot, gesturing dynamically with both hands toward a small black cast-iron skillet placed on the wooden table in front of her. The skillet contains a thick, golden-brown slice of French toast topped with a perfectly round scoop of white vanilla ice cream that is beginning to melt. (4) A tight close-up shot captures the physical action of a silver fork and knife cutting through the thick slice of French toast. The bread's interior is visibly moist and saturated with a pale yellow custard mixture, showing a soft and porous texture as the steam rises slightly from the hot surface. (5) The woman brings a large piece of the custard-soaked bread to her mouth and takes a significant bite. Her facial expression shifts to one of delight, with her eyes closing momentarily as she nods her head in rhythmic approval while chewing. Other customers are blurred in the background. (6) A second plate is presented, featuring a square slice of toasted bread topped with a dense, round mound of dark red bean paste and a square of yellow butter. Beside the toast is a colorful salad consisting of bright green lettuce leaves, shredded orange carrots, and a sliced red cherry tomato. (7) The woman spreads a portion of the red bean paste onto the corner of the toast using a butter knife. She then picks up the toast with her hands and takes another large bite, smiling broadly at the camera with an expression of intense satisfaction as she finishes the food.
